riskScore.notScoredHint: This asset's risk score has not been computed yet.
riskScore.recalc.desc: Apply current scoring configuration to all assets. This may take a moment for large portfolios.
riskScore.recalc.title: Recalculate scores
riskScore.calculatingHint: Its inputs changed; the new score is being computed.
riskScore.floor.desc: Findings on assets with no assigned owner can't be safely deprioritized, so keep them at P2 minimum. Off by default.
riskScore.floor.title: Floor unowned findings at P2
riskScore.model.amplifyHint: Highly-exposed critical assets no longer all pin at 100. The exposure boost fills the remaining range instead of overflowing, which improves ranking at the top.
riskScore.why.title: Why this score
riskScore.why.raisedFrom: raised from {value} by its business context
riskScore.why.noFindings: No open findings: nothing adds risk to this asset.
riskScore.why.pending: A rescore is queued; these figures already use the current inputs.
riskScore.why.howItWorks: The worst severity sets the findings score; more findings of the same severity add less each time. Known-exploited findings count one severity higher.
riskScore.impact.title: Review the impact
riskScore.impact.description: What these settings change across the whole organization, computed exactly as the change will be applied.
riskScore.impact.overridesKept: {count} findings with a manual priority keep it.
riskScore.impact.forwardOnly: Applies from now on: open findings and their assets are recomputed in the background. Closed findings, past trends and reports keep their values. A deadline only ever moves earlier. You will be asked to confirm your identity.
riskScore.impact.applied: Settings applied. Scores are being recomputed in the background.
riskScore.impact.recalculateQueued: {count} assets queued for a new risk score.
riskScore.model.label: Score composition
riskScore.model.likelihoodImpactHint: Risk = findings score × exposure % × criticality % × (1 − control reduction).
riskScore.model.multiplyHint: Exposure multiplier scales the whole score.
riskScore.model.notice: Risk is the findings score times the exposure and criticality factors below, lowered by compensating controls. Component weights, exposure multipliers, finding impact and CTEM points apply only to the weighted compositions; choose one under Score composition to edit them.
riskScore.model.howLikelihood: Risk = findings score × exposure factor × criticality factor × (1 − control reduction). The findings score grows with each open finding by severity, with diminishing returns; exploit signals count one severity higher.
riskScore.model.howLikelihoodZero: An asset with no open finding has a risk of 0. Exposure and criticality scale risk; they are not risk on their own.
